note: BH-8739: settings row lib.group-findings.<board>.group_findings_areas. A JSON object that maps a route prefix to a product area name, for example {"/portal":"member portal"}. gf_run groups a finding under `area:<name>` of the longest prefix that matches on a `/` segment boundary, else under the first path segment of its route. A value that is not a JSON object of names counts as {} and writes one `areas-invalid` ledger row. Empty or {} (the default) groups by first path segment. Read by gf_run through _gf_knob.
